title: Slovakian Chickpea Lasagna
description: A hearty and flavorful lasagna dish inspired by Slovakian cuisine, featuring roasted chickpeas and a blend of cheeses.

ingredients.name: Slovakian Cheese Blend (or Mozzarella and Cheddar)

instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a pan, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add tomato sauce and bring to a simmer.
Stir in roasted chickpeas and Slovakian cheese blend.
In a separate bowl, combine chopped parsley and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spread a layer of tomato sauce in the bottom of a baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the chickpea and cheese mixture on top of the noodles.
Sprinkle with parsley mixture and repeat the layers.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for 30-35 minutes.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
